name: MediaFetch Pro Adobe CEP
releaseNotes: v1.7.4: Complete UI Glass Theme synchronization & enhanced text contrast! All header bars, media type selector buttons, project badges, target folder labels, analyze buttons, and search studio thumbnail expand/zoom controls now seamlessly match the chosen Glass theme (Frosted, Clear, Blur) with crystal-clear high-contrast text legibility across every theme.
Fixed YouTube premieres and upcoming live stream metadata detection with cover download.
Resolved continuous update alert popup by synchronizing build version code.
Full multi-media extraction for Behance projects and carousels across desktop and mobile APK.
Fixed links and download handling across all platforms without failure.
